config.tabby-zoom.initialZoom.tooltip: How far you zoom in when pressing the zoom key.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicCamera.toolti: Smooths the camera movement while zooming, like OptiFine.
config.tabby-zoom.relativeSensitivity.to: Lowers the mouse sensitivity the further you zoom in.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicZoomKey.toolt: Zooms with cinematic camera and bars, no matter what is set above.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicZoomHideHud.t: Hides the HUD and hand like F1 while the cinematic zoom is held.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicBars.tooltip: Shows black bars at the top and bottom while zooming. Needs Cinematic Camera.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicBarSize.toolt: Height of each bar in percent of the screen height.
config.tabby-zoom.cinematicBarFade.toolt: How long the bars take to fade in and out.
config.tabby-zoom.smoothZoom.tooltip: Animates zooming in and out instead of jumping instantly.
config.tabby-zoom.zoomSpeed.tooltip: How fast the smooth zoom animation is.
config.tabby-zoom.scrollZoom.tooltip: Use the mouse wheel while zooming to zoom further in or out.
config.tabby-zoom.scrollStep.tooltip: How much one scroll step multiplies the zoom.
config.tabby-zoom.maxZoom.tooltip: How far you can zoom in by scrolling.
